AUTHOR: Christensen
TITLE: Detection, localization and classification of fish and fish species in poor conditions using convolutional neural networks
REGION: Training: Danish aquariums (Fiskeri- & Søfartsmuseet, Esbjerg); in-situ test: Weser river (Bremen) and Baltic Sea off Rügen, Germany
DATA: Own aquarium dataset (3 acquisition campaigns, 13,124 annotated images, 4,593 fish); own in-situ sea/river dataset (97 fish)
V_EV: Sec. V: 'The visibility in the water is at best 30-40 cm and the low-light conditions introduce extensive motion blur.'
D2: Aquarium train/eval split not reported; 17 sea images added to training, remaining sea images (97 fish total) used for evaluation
D_EV: Sec. V: 'The 17 samples are not included in the evaluation set and have been manually chosen to have minimum correlation with the evaluation set.'
R_EV: Sec. V: 'Given that OFDNet has been trained on good condition aquarium data ... it obtains a 0.21 mAP' (vs aquarium mAP 0.55, Sec. III)
C_EV: no statement found (no detection confidence threshold value or false-positive handling reported; Fig. 5 only shows confidences on boxes)
E_EV: Sec. V: 'OFDNet obtains a 0.56 mAP and successfully detects 66.7 % of the fishes included in the dataset and furthermore classifies 89.7 % of these correctly.'
ARCH: OFDNet = SSD with MobileNet feature extractor (300x300 input)
METR: mAP, per-class AP, % fish detected, % correctly classified
NOTE: INCL: training data are aquarium images (P4 would exclude), but in-situ results on Weser/Baltic imagery are reported separately (0.21 mAP without, 0.56 mAP with 17 sea images added), so INCL=Y per Clarification 6. D: headline results are on the sea dataset; 17 sea images were manually (not randomly) selected at image level for training, closest category is image-level split; D4=Y because selection to minimise correlation with evaluation set is explicitly stated. Aquarium train/eval split unit never stated. Verifier should check D1 choice. V1: 'visibility at best 30-40 cm' coded as other quantitative (rough visibility range, no instrument); V6=P because performance is given for good-condition aquarium vs murky sea data (qualitative strata). R: aquarium->sea is a different water condition/site/setting with numbers for both (R3=Y). E4: detection rate (complement of FNR) reported. PLAT: aquarium for training, in-situ platform for sea data not specified (coded 혼합). Sea-test image count not reported.
